blocks.arabic_text: مِنْهَا الْقُلُوبُ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: إِنَّ هذِهِ مَوْعِظَةُ مُوَدِّعٍ فَبِمَاذَا تَعْهَدُ إِلَيْنَا يَارَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: أُوصِيكُمْ بِتَقْوَي اللهِ، وَالسَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ وَإِنْ عَبْدٌ حَبَشِيٌّ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَعِشْ مِنْكُمْ يَرَ اخْتِلَافاً كَثِيرًا، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَمُحْدَثَاتِ اْلاَُمُورِ فَإِنَّهَا ضَلَالَةٌ، فَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ ذلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَعَلَيْهِ بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ الْمَهْدِيِّينَ عَضُّوا عَلَيْهَا بِالنَّوَاجِذِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في الاخذ بالسنة......،رقم:٢٦٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “One day after the Fajr Salah, the Prophet ﷺ delivered a sermon among us. (That sermon had a deep effect on us.) On hearing it, tears flowed from our eyes. Hearts trembled with fear. At that moment a man asked (the Prophet ﷺ), ‘O Messenger of Allah! Does this not seem like the advice of someone bidding farewell (before a long journey)? What do you advise us about?’ The Prophet ﷺ replied, ‘I advise you to fear Allah, and to listen to and obey (your leader) even if he is a black slave. Whoever among you lives (after me) will see many kinds of disputes. At that time keep yourselves completely away from inventing new things in the Deen (that are not part of it). For every new thing invented (in the name of the Deen) is misguidance. If you happen to live in such a time, hold firmly to my way and the way of the rightly guided Caliphs! Bite onto them firmly with your molar teeth! Do not let go of it under any circumstances!’” Hazrat Irbad ibn Sariyah (RA) narrates this.
